item.description: By MARCIA DUNN CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla. item.title: Pier improvement project begins in Pascagoula
item.description: PASCAGOULA, Miss. (WXXV)- In Pascagoula, the Beach Park Pier Improvement Project begins Monday. This project will replace and upgrade handrails and decking along part of the pier. Improvements include new ADA-compliant handrails and flow-through decking, enhancing accessibility, safety, and durability. The pier will be closed to the public while this work is being done. Categories: Featured, Local News
